note: Both sets contain two significant factual errors regarding the table data: both list M2 thickness as 190 mm (source: 100 mm), Set B misreads M2 radius as -1,983 mm (source: -1,953 mm), and Set A misbinds M1 spacing to M2 with a hallucinated attribute ('obscuration'). Set A is preferred because it correctly extracts important textual claims regarding ray behavior (collimation, convergence) and instrument field-of-view directions that Set B omits, offering better coverage of the page's engineering content despite similar error counts and some duplicate entries.
